claim: The VeronaCard costs €27 for 24 hours and €32 for 48 hours in 2026, with free use of ATV public transport and complimentary admission to over 20 attractions including the Arena (fast-track), Casa di Giulietta, Torre dei Lamberti, Castelvecchio, San Zeno and the Cathedral.
quote: 24 hours: €27.00 ... 48 hours: €32.00 ... Free use of public transport for up to 48 hours ... complimentary admission to over 20 attractions

claim: The VeronaCard's free attractions list includes the Arena skip-the-line, Juliet's House balcony, Torre dei Lamberti, Castelvecchio, San Zeno Maggiore, the Duomo complex, Santa Anastasia, Arche Scaligere, Palazzo della Ragione, San Fermo Maggiore, and Juliet's Tomb, plus discounts on Giardino Giusti, city tours and opera.
quote: Free entry to the Arena, Juliet's House, Museum Castelvecchio and more. Use the city buses as often as you like ... discounts on more highlights – e.g. Giardino Giusti, city tour & opera.

claim: The Aerobus/Airlink (Line 199) shuttle links Verona Airport to Porta Nuova station and the centre for a €7 flat fare, runs every 20 minutes from 6:30am to 11:30pm, takes about 15 minutes, and the ticket is valid 75 minutes for transfers to city buses; contactless tap-on payment is supported.
quote: Airlink (Line 199) shuttle ... flat fare of €7 ... every 20 minutes until 11.30 p.m. The Aerobus journey takes 15 minutes ... valid for 75 minutes ... tap your contactless credit card or smartphone

claim: In June Verona averages roughly 27°C (81°F) by day and 17°C (63°F) at night, warming from about 26°C early in the month to 29°C by month's end, with around 99mm of rain across ~11 rainy days.
quote: In June, Verona averages 27°C (81°F) by day and 17°C (63°F) at night ... June sees approximately 99 mm (3.9 in) of rainfall over 11 rainy days.

claim: June daily highs in Verona typically range from about 75°F to 86°F (24-30°C) with overnight lows of 59-66°F (15-19°C).
quote: daily high temperatures ranging from 75° to 86°, with overnight lows between 59° and 66°, and the average high for June is 81° with an average low of 63°

claim: Verona's ZTL (limited traffic zone) covers nearly the entire historic centre with camera enforcement and, since late October, is enforced 24 hours; tourists may drive in only if their hotel is inside the ZTL and registers the licence plate with police.
quote: Restricted Traffic Zone 'ZTL' has been armoured for all 24 hours ... Tourists are allowed to drive into the city center only if their hotel is located within the ZTL ... he or she will register the license plate with the police

claim: Drivers should park in structured facilities on the ZTL edge such as Parcheggio Porta Palio (free, 1.5km southwest of Piazza Bra), connected to the centre by the ATV Linea E electric bus running every 15 minutes for €1.50 per trip or €4.00 a day in 2026.
quote: Parcheggio Porta Palio offers free parking 1.5 km southwest of Piazza Bra, connected to the center by the ATV Linea E electric bus that runs every 15 minutes ... costs €1.50 per trip, or €4.00 for a day pass in 2026

claim: Verona's historic centre is compact and very walkable with no metro, so buses or taxis are rarely needed except to and from the train station.
quote: Historical Verona is incredibly compact and walkable, with no tube or metro in the city, and you won't need to take the bus or taxis often except to/from the train station.

claim: The best time to visit Verona is April-May or September-October for mild weather and fewer crowds; summer brings hot, crowded conditions but also the Arena opera season, while winter is quietest and cheapest.
quote: the best time is from April to May or September to October when you'll get mild weather and fewer crowds ... Summer is the most popular time with hot weather and opera performances at the Arena di Verona, but it will also be very hot, busy and crowded

claim: To dodge crowds, arrive at the Arena around 8:15am before tour buses, visit weekdays rather than weekends when day-trippers flood in, and note Casa di Giulietta requires a timed reservation even with the VeronaCard.
quote: arriving by 8:15 AM (15 minutes before official opening) lets you admire the ancient amphitheater in peaceful solitude ... weekdays a better time to venture into the historic centre
